timeline_policy: Canon events are reference anchors only; player outcomes may diverge.

events.title: The voyage begins
events.summary: Luffy sets out from Dawn Island and gradually gathers the first members of his crew through a series of East Blue adventures.
events.canonical_outcome: A small pirate crew forms and sets its course toward the Grand Line.
events.player_hook: A new pirate can begin at the edge of the East Blue, meet local crews, and pursue a personal reason to sail.

events.title: The Arlong Park conflict
events.summary: Nami's connection to Arlong's rule is exposed, and the conflict culminates in the liberation of Cocoyasi Village.
events.canonical_outcome: Arlong's control over the village is broken and Nami is free to choose her own future.
events.player_hook: A player may encounter a village under pirate protection-rackets, investigate the local power structure, and decide whether to intervene.

chapter_milestones.label: Arlong is defeated
chapter_milestones.note: The conflict at Arlong Park reaches its decisive turning point.

events.title: The Alabasta conflict
events.summary: The Straw Hats help Vivi expose the plot behind Alabasta's civil conflict and confront the forces seeking to seize the kingdom.
events.canonical_outcome: Crocodile's takeover attempt is stopped and the fighting in Alabasta comes to an end.
events.player_hook: An arriving crew can take contracts from either side, investigate manipulated information, or seek a peaceful route before the conflict escalates.

events.title: The bell of Shandora
events.summary: The conflict in the sky island reaches its climax as the history of Shandora and the promise connected to its golden bell come to the surface.
events.canonical_outcome: The bell rings across the sky, reaching people below and resolving a long-standing promise.
events.player_hook: A crew may search for a lost signal, learn competing versions of an island's history, and choose whose account to trust.

chapter_milestones.label: The Golden Bell rings
chapter_milestones.note: Luffy rings the Great Golden Bell, allowing its sound to reach the people below.

chapter_milestones.label: The war's aftermath
chapter_milestones.note: Skypieans and Shandians begin rebuilding and celebrate the end of their long conflict.

events.title: The Davy Back challenge
events.summary: A pirate crew uses the Davy Back Fight to challenge another crew and put membership and pride at stake.
events.canonical_outcome: The challenge concludes and the crews continue their voyages.
events.player_hook: A rival crew may propose a multi-round contest with negotiable stakes; the player can refuse, renegotiate, or compete.

events.title: The Water Seven crisis
events.summary: The crew faces a crisis over its damaged ship, while Robin's disappearance and the secrets of Water Seven pull the island into a larger conflict.
events.canonical_outcome: The crew's internal conflict and the mystery surrounding Robin lead directly into the events at Enies Lobby.
events.player_hook: A ship-repair stop can become a story about scarce materials, shipwright politics, loyalty, and the cost of replacing a beloved vessel.

events.title: The Enies Lobby rescue
events.summary: The Straw Hats confront the World Government's agents to bring Robin back, making their loyalty to a crewmate unmistakable.
events.canonical_outcome: Robin and Franky are rescued, and the crew escapes after openly challenging the Government.
events.player_hook: A rescue mission can branch between stealth, negotiation, sabotage, and direct assault, with consequences for allies and wanted status.

chapter_milestones.label: Robin asks to live
chapter_milestones.note: Robin openly asks the crew to take her back to sea after the Government flag is burned.

chapter_milestones.label: Lucci is defeated
chapter_milestones.note: Luffy defeats Lucci and the rescue reaches its decisive payoff.

events.title: The Thriller Bark shadow crisis
events.summary: The crew enters a ship-like island in the Florian Triangle, where stolen shadows and an army of zombies threaten visitors.
events.canonical_outcome: Moria's scheme is stopped and Brook is able to continue his journey.
events.player_hook: A fogbound ship graveyard can host a mystery about stolen identities, missing shadows, and bargains with an isolated power.

events.title: The Sabaody separation
events.summary: The crew's encounter with overwhelming forces at Sabaody ends with its members scattered to different destinations.
events.canonical_outcome: The Straw Hats are separated and must survive and grow independently before reuniting.
events.player_hook: A high-risk port incident can split a player crew, opening parallel survival and reunion storylines without forcing the same separation.

events.title: The Amazon Lily arrival
events.summary: Luffy arrives on a secluded island ruled by the Kuja and learns more about the crisis surrounding his brother.
events.canonical_outcome: Luffy gains a path toward Impel Down and the attempt to reach Ace.
events.player_hook: A shipwrecked outsider must navigate unfamiliar customs, earn trust, and decide whether to aid a stranger's desperate mission.

events.title: The Impel Down breakout
events.summary: A desperate rescue attempt turns into a prison escape involving prisoners and former enemies who temporarily cooperate.
events.canonical_outcome: A group of inmates escapes and heads toward the coming war.
events.player_hook: A prison-break scenario can be solved through alliances, forged access, diversion, or a risky breakout, with trust between temporary allies at stake.

events.title: The Summit War
events.summary: The rescue of Ace collides with a world-scale war, whose losses and aftermath reshape the balance of power and the age of piracy.
events.canonical_outcome: The war ends with major losses and the world enters a new period of upheaval.
events.player_hook: The player may experience the war as a distant news event, a supply run, an evacuation, or a personal mission; participation is optional.

chapter_milestones.label: Ace dies
chapter_milestones.note: Ace dies protecting Luffy, marking a major turning point in the war.

chapter_milestones.label: The war concludes
chapter_milestones.note: The Marineford battle reaches its conclusion and the world enters a changed era.

events.title: The Fish-Man Island rebellion
events.summary: After reuniting, the Straw Hats become involved in a conflict rooted in discrimination, inherited hatred, and the future of Fish-Man Island.
events.canonical_outcome: Hody Jones's rebellion is defeated and the island's unresolved social wounds remain a major concern.
events.player_hook: A player can support relief efforts, investigate extremist recruitment, protect civilians, or negotiate between communities.

events.title: The Punk Hazard alliance
events.summary: An alliance forms on a dangerous island split by extreme environments, exposing experiments and a supply chain tied to the underworld.
events.canonical_outcome: The alliance's conflict with Caesar's operation sets up a wider confrontation with the underworld.
events.player_hook: A hazardous research island can generate rescue, sabotage, evidence-gathering, and escape routes with competing factions.

events.title: The Dressrosa uprising
events.summary: The truth behind Dressrosa's ruler and its transformed citizens emerges as an uprising challenges the Donquixote Family.
events.canonical_outcome: Doflamingo's rule ends and the Straw Hat Grand Fleet is formed from allied crews.
events.player_hook: A kingdom-wide cover-up can be investigated through witnesses, missing records, underground markets, and alliances with local groups.

chapter_milestones.label: Dressrosa is liberated
chapter_milestones.note: Doflamingo's defeat is confirmed and the people begin reclaiming their freedom.

events.title: The secret of Zou
events.summary: The Minks reveal the depth of their loyalty and the island becomes a key link between the Straw Hats, Wano, and the Road Poneglyphs.
events.canonical_outcome: The alliance gains crucial information and a new direction for its journey.
events.player_hook: A hidden community can test whether a visitor respects its customs and protectors before it shares sensitive information.

events.title: The Whole Cake Island escape
events.summary: A political marriage becomes a trap, and the crew's attempt to bring Sanji home turns into a dangerous escape from Big Mom's territory.
events.canonical_outcome: The crew escapes Totto Land after securing important information and surviving the collapse of the wedding plan.
events.player_hook: A player can infiltrate a powerful family's celebration, negotiate with relatives, steal records, or help an ally escape.

chapter_milestones.label: The crew escapes Totto Land
chapter_milestones.note: The Thousand Sunny group successfully escapes the territory, while the wider conflict continues.

events.title: The Levely
events.summary: Leaders from across the world gather at Mary Geoise while hidden political tensions and unseen operations move beneath the public summit.
events.canonical_outcome: The summit closes with major unanswered questions and consequences for the world's political order.
events.player_hook: This event is best represented through newspapers, rumors, diplomatic requests, and changes to regional conditions rather than forcing the player into the summit.

events.title: The raid on Onigashima
events.summary: An alliance challenges Kaidou and his forces, while Wano's history and the Kozuki family's fate become central to the battle.
events.canonical_outcome: Kaidou's rule is broken and Wano enters a new period under Momonosuke.
events.player_hook: A player may join the resistance, smuggle supplies, free prisoners, or remain outside Wano and learn the result through news.

events.title: The Egghead incident
events.summary: The Straw Hats become involved in Vegapunk's research and a confrontation that exposes more of the world's hidden history before they escape the island.
events.canonical_outcome: The incident sends shockwaves through the world and the Straw Hats depart toward Elbaph.
events.player_hook: Represent the incident through optional research contracts, extraction missions, scientific rumors, and global news updates.

events.title: The Elbaph adventure begins
events.summary: The crew reaches the land of the giants, where its layered geography, old friendships, inherited history, and new conflicts open the next stage of the voyage.
events.canonical_outcome: Ongoing; outcomes must be extended only after verifying newer manga chapters.
events.player_hook: Elbaph can be an optional high-level destination with exploration, giant culture, ancient records, and political tensions; avoid hardcoding unresolved outcomes.

chapter_milestones.label: Elbaph arc begins
chapter_milestones.note: The official story index marks chapter 1127 as the beginning of the Elbaph arc.

chapter_milestones.label: Luffy encounters Loki
chapter_milestones.note: The crew identifies Elbaph and Luffy encounters the chained prince Loki.
